name: Callow & Vex Patchwork Cargo Trouser
description: Not a manufactured product — these are second-hand cargo pants repaired and resold by the Callow & Vex depot stall in Meridian's Shelf market districts. Each pair is different: mismatched patches on the knees, replaced pocket panels in contrasting fabric, restitched seams. Structurally sound despite appearances. A patchwork pair in good condition is a minor point of pride on the Shelf.
what_it_says: You're on the Shelf and you're making it work — or you're from Tier 2 and buying into Shelf culture deliberately.
story_hooks: Experienced Shelf dwellers can sometimes identify the origin of a pair's patches — a distinctive corporate fabric on a knee panel might mean the original pants came from a specific employer.
Callow & Vex keeps rough records of what they take in; they've been quietly asked by investigators more than once to check if a specific pair passed through their stock.
